verified_facts.text: The Atlantis resort is located on Paradise Island, across the harbor from Nassau.
verified_facts.excerpt: Atlantis is located on Paradise Island across the harbor from Nassau.

verified_facts.text: The Royal is the center of the Atlantis resort and home to the Royal towers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Royal at Atlantis is the center of the resort and home to the iconic Royal towers.

verified_facts.text: The Royal is steps from Aquaventure, The Dig and the Atlantis Casino.
verified_facts.excerpt: Steps from Aquaventure, The Dig, and the Atlantis Casino

verified_facts.text: The Royal's design features the mythology of the Lost City of Atlantis risen from the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Royal is the icon of Atlantis, featuring awe-inspiring mythology of the Lost City of Atlantis risen from the sea.

verified_facts.text: The Royal's rooms and suites feature contemporary furnishings, luxurious bedding and modern amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience The Royal luxury hotel rooms and suites offering new design features of contemporary furnishings, luxurious bedding, and modern amenities.

verified_facts.text: The Bridge Suite spans the open-air connection between the East and West wings of The Royal and has been featured in many films and television productions.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Bridge Suite has been featured in many films and television productions and spans the open air connection between the East and West wings of The Royal.

verified_facts.text: The Bridge Suite has a living room with a grand piano and a dining room with a 22-karat gold chandelier.
verified_facts.excerpt: a 1,250-square-foot living room with a grand piano and twin entertainment centers, a dining room adorned with a 22-karat gold chandelier

verified_facts.text: Grand Suites at The Royal have a master bedroom with Caribbean beach views and a huge walk-in closet.
verified_facts.excerpt: an opulent Master Bedroom offering splendid Caribbean beach views, a plush king-size bed, desk, two chairs, and a huge walk-in closet

verified_facts.text: Regal Suites at The Royal offer sweeping views of the Caribbean, the harbour and marina, or the tropical landscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: Regal Suites at The Royal offer resort guests a truly sumptuous accommodation with sweeping views of the Caribbean, harbour, and Marina or tropical landscape

verified_facts.text: Imperial Club at The Royal offers exclusive lounge access, enhanced services and personalized hospitality.
verified_facts.excerpt: Imperial Club offers discerning travelers an elevated stay with exclusive lounge access, enhanced services, and personalized hospitality

verified_facts.text: Imperial Club access is included with select room categories.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club access is included with select room categories

verified_facts.text: The Royal Baths, with The Royal as a backdrop, are a setting where guests can unwind.
verified_facts.excerpt: With The Royal as a dramatic backdrop, the Royal Baths create a setting of serenity where guests can unwind

verified_facts.text: The Dig, inside The Royal, brings guests face to face with sea life including manta rays, eels and angelfish.
verified_facts.excerpt: Come face to face with over 250 species of sea life including manta rays, eels, and angelfish.

verified_facts.text: Plato's at The Royal offers quick bites for breakfast, dinner or a late-night snack, with live nightly entertainment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Offers quick bites for breakfast, dinner, or a late-night snack. Catch sports events on one of four large flat screen TVs or unwind with live nightly entertainment.

verified_facts.text: The Royal offers easy access to Atlantis's white-sand beaches, open-air marine habitats, swimming pools and Aquaventure water park.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Royal offers easy access to five miles of white-sand beaches, open-air marine habitats, the casino, multiple restaurants, and numerous water-focused amenities including swimming pools and Aquaventure water park.

verified_facts.text: The Atlantis marine habitats span 14 lagoons with more than 50,000 aquatic animals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Make your way through 14 lagoons with 8 million gallons of ocean water & more than 50,000 aquatic animals representing over 250 marine species

verified_facts.text: The Atlantis Casino links The Royal and The Coral and spans a lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Linking The Royal and The Coral, our world-class casino spans a 7-acre lagoon

verified_facts.text: Mandara Spa at Atlantis blends Balinese healing, European therapies and natural elements unique to The Bahamas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mandara Spa blends ancient Balinese healing, traditional European therapies & natural elements unique to The Bahamas

verified_facts.text: For guests of The Royal, the In-Transit lounge is between the East and West wings.
verified_facts.excerpt: For guest of The Royal, the In-Transit lounge is located in between the East and West wings.

verified_facts.text: Atlantis Paradise Island is a cash-free resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Atlantis Paradise Island is a cash free resort.

verified_facts.text: Aquaventure's Rapids River surrounds the Power Tower and is the longest river in the Bahamas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrounding the Power Tower is the Rapids River, the longest river in the Bahamas.
